text:
jordan: Hey — customer says their client-side SDK estimator reports ~2,300 tokens but the invoice shows ~3,100. They attached the SDK log + a server response excerpt. Looks like a ~35% delta. Suspect hidden system messages or function/tool tokens. cc @katie @billing-bot

katie: Can you paste the exact SDK command they ran and the payload (sanitized)? Also need invoice id so billing can look it up.

jordan: Here are the snippets they gave:
```bash
# SDK estimator (JS)
const est = sdk.estimateTokens({messages: messagesArray})
// => 2293
```
```bash
# curl used to call our API (customer)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer x..." -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","input":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant"},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize..."}], "stream": false }'
```
Invoice: INV-4528 (2026-03-01)

billing-bot: Invoice INV-4528 shows 3,154 billed tokens on model redwood-1-large for that invoice period. Line item metadata: model=redwood-1-large, region=us-east-1, no separate tool line item recorded.

mike: Two quick things to check: 1) server-inserted system messages (we've seen sidecars add audit/system prompts) which the client's estimator may not include; 2) function_call tokens — when the assistant returns function call name + args we include those as tokens server-side and they often blow up counts if the args are large. Also streaming can shift how clients estimate (they sometimes stop estimating early).

linh: Quick note: our JS estimator historically EXCLUDES system messages and tool outputs by default to match common user expectations and reduce noise. There are flags to include them. Ask them to run the estimator with includeSystem: true and includeToolOutput: true. Example:
```js
const est = estimator.estimate({
  messages: messagesArray,
  options: { includeSystem: true, includeToolOutput: true }
})
console.log(est.totalTokens) // should be closer to invoice
```
Also if they used a pre-call estimator that runs before tool invocation it will miss tokens added after the initial assistant response (e.g., toolOutput appended by our runtime).

jordan: I'm asking the customer to re-run and to paste the full server response (including assistant.function_call and any system messages) and the estimator output with the new flags. I'll also ask them whether they called streaming or non-streaming.

katie: If they can't reproduce locally, escalate to billing with: 1) estimator output (default and with includeSystem/tool), 2) full response JSON from our API, 3) invoice ids + timestamps, and 4) which SDK version they used. We'll diff the two tokenizations and check the metering pipeline for injected audit messages.

jordan: Customer repro'd. They found an internal audit system message inserted by a sidecar: `{ "role": "system", "content": "[internal/audit] prompt augmented with user metadata..." }` — that alone added ~780 tokens. They ran estimator with includeSystem/tool and now their client estimate matches invoice within noise.

billing-bot: Escalation created: BLG-7781. Assigned to eng-billing. Initial response ETA: 24h.

katie: Thanks — filing a small docs note to call out that client estimators exclude system/tool by default and to recommend the include flags for accurate pre-billing estimates. :thumbsup:
